bug_info.bug_desc: The core tracer references id_stage_i.operand_b_fw_id, but that identifier is neither declared nor driven in the pre-merge ID stage. Tracer-enabled elaboration therefore cannot resolve this hierarchical operand-B observation signal. The architectural ALU operand-B path is separately assigned.
bug_info.fix_hint: Declare the 32-bit operand_b_fw_id observation signal and drive it from regfile_data_rb_id for the tracer connection.
